text:
Anya: quick sync — post-GA mini-iteration planning. We need a decision today: focus the 2-week slice on customer-blocking bugs or ship a small personalization enhancement that customers asked for. list below and proposed pattern.

Ravi: +1 to triage first. can you paste the customer impact numbers? :eyes:

Anya: pasted numbers from support: login failures ~1200 users/day (10% of new signups), embed streaming regressions affecting 3 top accounts (support escalations), and a caching mismatch causing stale suggestions for some orgs.

Sam: my read — login NPE is sev1 and blocks onboarding. streaming regression is high-rep but narrow. caching is annoying but low freq. If we only have one eng slot for 2 weeks, fix the login bug and one medium bug.

Jordan: on the enhancement side — personalization A/B is low risk, but requires backend changes and a new eval. timeline estimate: 6 days eng + 2 days QA + rollout config. Can be done with nonblocking work if we have two folks.

Anya: Proposal: 1) Mandatory: address login NPE (must ship in mini-iteration). 2) Stretch: if we finish early, do streaming regression. 3) Defer personalization to next mini-iteration unless we can allocate a second engineer. Thoughts?

Ravi: agree with ordering. also propose a hard acceptance criteria for login fix: 0 login NPEs in 24h on canary + rollback plan. add automated alert key and runbook.

Sam: +1. quick triage checklist I used: 
```
- reproduce
- root cause pr
- test coverage added
- canary (5%)
- monitor p99 / error rate
```

Jordan: for personalization, can we split to infra work first (schema + flag) so we make progress without risking GA stability? small PRs that don't touch runtime path.

Anya: yes. if we accept the above plan, I'll update the sprint board, mark the login bug as pinned, create a canary rollout task, and notify support + AE owners.

Ravi: i'll own the login bug fix. timeline: start today, aim for PR by EOD tomorrow, canary by Wednesday.

Sam: i'll take streaming regression triage as stretch. will add minimal tests and a diff that allows rollback by feature-flag.

Anya: Jordan can you scope the personalization infra spike as a separate card (2 days) so we can start in background?

Jordan: will do. card created: PERSONAL-221 "personalization: infra spike + flag" with AC and risk notes. linking in board. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-checklist reminder — update runbooks for any customer-facing fixes and tag releases with changelog entry.

Anya: OK team — final call: login bug = top priority (must ship), streaming regression = stretch, personalization infra spike = background if capacity. I'll send short note to sales/support with commitment window.

Ravi: :thumbsup:

Sam: Thanks — started triage thread in eng-runtime.

Jordan: adding QA acceptance criteria to the personalization card now.

Anya: closing this thread. will post updated board link in #product later today.
